[Intro]
[D]
I'm a rollin' stone

[D]all [G]alone and lost

[G]all the people
[D]say Just another guy
on the [G]lost high-
[D]way Just a deck of cards

[Verse 2]
[D]and a [G]jug of wine
[D]And a woman's lies
makes a life like mine
[A]On the day we met,
[G]I went as-
[D]tray I started rollin' down
that [G]lost high-
[D]way

[Intrelude]
[D]  [G]
[D]
[A]
[G]
[D]

[Verse 3]

just a kid like you
[A]And now I'm lost,
[G]too late to
[D]pray Lord I paid a cost
on the [A]lost high-
[D]way Now boys don't start
